hooks.name: Prompt Change Eval
hooks.description: When a system prompt, agent definition, or model id changes, re-run the offline eval set before it ships.

action.prompt: A prompt, agent definition, or model id changed. Prompts are code: (1) identify which golden-set cases in evals/ exercise the changed behaviour; (2) run the offline eval harness and compare against the thresholds in evals/thresholds.yaml; (3) report any metric that regressed — especially faithfulness, citation coverage, and tool-selection accuracy — with the specific failing cases. Do not loosen a threshold; if the change is intentional, say so and leave the threshold decision to the reviewer.
